shortDescription: Morgan Stanley researchers said lenders need greater disclosure to assess credit risk tied to property developers after the collapse of Sydney’s Bathla Group, according to Bloomberg.The note pointed to Bathla as an example of why more information is needed on developer credit exposure.

title: Morgan Stanley Urges More Credit Disclosure After Bathla Collapse
